entries.en: How is this woman so strong!?[n]It feels like my body is being[n]kneaded with iron rods...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: So? What do you think about the amount[n]of force I'm using, Masterrr?
...It's perfect.
...Take it down a notch.
...I don't feel anything.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Right? I'm a professional at this, after all.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You really want me to go lower with[n]the force, huh? I could use more force[n]if you wanted, but...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, really? Okay, I'll just go ahead and[n]use more force then.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Huh. Your body is pretty fit. What the[n]heck do you do to get it like this?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You're sooo stiff... There's knots[n]everywhere...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I can't believe my own student[n]requested a massage. It's not weird,[n]but if people found out...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, you are pretty well-built despite[n]your looks. I guess your clothes make[n]you seem thinner.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Ah, when you press down on this area,[n]it hurts sooo much.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Oh? You just fidgeted a little,[n]didn't you?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Ah, your spine... You need to watch[n]your posture so you don't end up[n]hunchbacked, okay?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: So, do you feel a bit lighter now?
My body really does feel[n]lighter. Any fatigue I[n]felt earlier is all gone...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Phew... That should do it...
My body feels lighter...[n]It's also easier to move...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ooh, looks like that was pretty effective.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: All right, I'm heading home. Don't[n]overwork yourself, okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, since you're refreshed now, you can[n]probably do something else before the[n]night ends.
I'm feeling so refreshed,[n]I think I can do something[n]else before the night ends...
